title: Indexes and joins
body: A selective index lets the database find matching rows without reading the whole table. A join is correct because of the relationship between keys, not because it runs quickly. Check the query plan before adding an index, and remember that every extra index slows writes.

eli5.analogy: Think of Indexes and joins as a small tool with one job.
